description: This file defines the implementation of the 'gn outputs' command, which lists output files for given targets or source files in the build system. It includes command help text, constants, and the main function RunOutputs that processes command-line arguments, resolves targets/files, and outputs the corresponding build outputs.

methods.name: RunOutputs
methods.description: Main function that processes command-line arguments, resolves targets and files, and prints the output files.
